## Topics in Time Series Econometrics

### HS 821

- Univariate time-series models
- Nonstationarity and unit roots
- Volatility modelling
- Vector autoregressions
- Cointegration
- Bayesian and frequentist inference

## Course organisation

- Two lectures each week
- R-based computational exercises
- Lecture notes available on the course website
- Datasets distributed through Moodle

## Software

Students will use:

- R
- Jupyter
- Quarto
- Relevant R packages

## Data access

Course datasets are distributed only through Moodle.

Download the datasets and place them inside the local `data` folder.
